list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned
note: Names and descriptions are as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry; where a fact comes from another guide it is cited beside the trophy, never copied. Difficulty and time estimates are PowerPyx's (4/10, about 200 hours) and Push Square's (up to 300 hours or more). All 55 trophies are offline and single-player, and one playthrough is enough. Cheats disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (60–80 hours)
roadmap.text: Finish the five chapters and do the character questlines as they unlock. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (there is no mission replay). The one thing you must not skip: the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, the only possibly missable trophy. Scan vehicles and study animals with binoculars as you go — the 100% checklist counts progress made during the story.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Free-roam cleanup: the 100% checklist (about 100 hours)
roadmap.text: After the story, Progress > Stats > 100% Completion shows the checklist. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable. The only things that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests; you need 70 of 80 challenges. Most trophies in this guide pop while you work the checklist.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Final sweep: Strangers & Freaks and leftovers (about 10 hours)
roadmap.text: Stranger strands are not needed for 100%, so finish the 8 that count, then mop up whatever the checklist left behind. The platinum pops the moment the last of the other 54 is earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Because A Long Road (100% completion) is one of the 54, the platinum is really a 100% run plus the miscellaneous trophies. Keep this page's checklist as your single source of truth and tick each trophy off as it pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: the 100% Completion checklist, found at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is over — progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you need 70 of 80 challenges. The only things that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Work through the checklist after the story; nothing on it is missable. Time-savers from PowerPyx: do optional missions as they appear (any 100 count, and there are far more than that), scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (200 of 277 base models) and study animals through binoculars (100 of 255) as you go.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida (the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy). Stunts come in four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and see found stunts on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will almost certainly do all nine naturally while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread over 12 ranges. The gold medals are not too punishing, and the ranges also feed your Focus level, which you need for Gunslinger. Work through the ranges one by one after the story; PowerPyx has a per-range gold guide if one challenge sticks.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races exist, but you only need one win per location. Drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, so they are not optional anyway; do them as part of the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many chances as you need. Pick the short ones and work through them; car races, race challenges and drone races all sit under the Activities umbrella, and wins here also feed Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you about a fishing challenge at a spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat him at fishing. If the text has not arrived yet, keep playing the story — it comes after that mission.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four in-game video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline, Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Five quests follow — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops when the last one is done. The quests stay available after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you, then is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento, and sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch of the story after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2–3, so nothing here is missable.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops when the last one is done. Still available after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters include Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), and PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being found. Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, so save this for the final sweep and watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, 'Randy's Wish List', marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered; the map marks some for you (Robberies > Randy's Wish List) and you can steal others off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage in west Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more. Doable after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline, Jason only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point at Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you Spin On This (shut down the labs); finish it and the trophy pops. Still available after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That meditation vanishes after Chapter 1 and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it to be safe. The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline, Jason only, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His quests are hunts: he marks animals with purple icons, you hunt them and bring them back. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker), and one clean shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more. The exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work through his hunts; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total; you only need three full sets. Cards are a collectible type — grab sets as you explore and this comes naturally during the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It (scan with the phone app: hold Up, then R1) at 100 locations. There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures plus the No Flusher tags — so scan anything that glows as you pass it. You will likely pass 100 while doing Whip It Good and the vehicle scans for 100%.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (eight groups of ten). The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while working on other trophies, then pick the easiest remaining ones — there are ten more than you need, so skip the hardest.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. You need duo free-roam, unlocked after Coffee Break (Chapter 2); call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route because the helicopter cannot see you on the tracks. The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also tends to pop naturally during bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. You need duo play (after Coffee Break). Hit three robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3); rob a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 on a vehicle) is the fast way — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. You only need to scan them, not drive them, and 200 scans are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Progress > Vehicles.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (eat or drink, wash up at home, or use Adrenaline to extend it), wear body armor, and line up five enemies at a gang operation with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets much easier at higher levels.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not one parked on the airfield; it must be connected to a boarding bridge. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and board directly, get to the cockpit upstairs, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) — that unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry robberies (green icons). Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (never kick the door), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.target_note: bank vaults (8 large bank jobs; all 8 needed for 100%)
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his Payday Loans quests) to find more vaults. Each robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then switch cars to go unrecognized. Up to $205,000 per bank, so this is also the best endgame money.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…), since robbing a vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map (52 areas). The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.target_note: gangs (39 illegal operations; all needed for 100%)
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total (all needed for 100%); one per gang is enough here. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini; drink it while standing next to the bar with the view, and the trophy pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only that blue Banshee counts; the pop is slightly delayed, after you drive away down the street.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation), steal all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but you do not need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so you can come back for whatever you missed. The trophy pops after you escape the police.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is raised by working out — buy a gym membership and train, always bringing your partner along (Right + Triangle to call them) so both train at once. You can switch characters only after Coffee Break (Chapter 2); check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia. There are gyms all over Vice City (filter Activities on the map), and you can work out at home after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitating enemies and kills all feed the profile in different directions (Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho — and Irredeemable, which is permanent, so avoid going overboard). It builds passively through every robbery and fight, so it should pop while you chase the other trophies.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed as of the latest guides — PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. Treat this as a watch-this-space entry: check the cited guide for updates rather than chasing a guess.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky); approach it, it drops a woman it abducted, talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians (Square) within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in one hit, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route since they are the priciest. The count is cumulative across every shop type, so it builds on its own while you gear up.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (12 exist in total; 4 are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 altogether. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles / Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need garage space first — each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. Note: Moses only takes vehicles without trackers at first.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
